text_462843145.text:
ENT purpose

Revolutionary, in every sense

text.text: Customers and patients deserve extraordinary. Inspired by the life-changing work of our customers, we deliver innovation, education and support that reshapes the standard, allowing patients to experience their senses more fully.

text_copy.text:
A sense
of purpose

Your patients count on you, and you can count on us. Together we're driven to change the lives of the patients you serve.

A force
for innovation

Together we're revolutionizing relief and transforming your surgical experience. Count on us for performance-driven products that are intuitive, connected, and feel better in your hands.

text.text:
A source
of knowledge

Our goal is to be your source of education for all things ENT – helping you learn new techniques, hone your craft and elevate your practice.

text_copy_copy.text:
ENT navigation system

The Stryker ENT navigation system powered by Scopis software, is a next-generation solution for navigating functional endoscopic sinus surgery with the ability to adjust course in critical areas help enhance patient safety.1,2 System real-time feedback is designed to deliver essential information to the care team, optimizing case setup and maintaining accuracy. 

LEARN MORE

Pello microdebrider

Powered by Stryker’s CORE 2 console, the Pello microdebrider has proprietary blades designed to reduce clogging and transform your ENT surgical experience. With its balanced ergonomic design and the power and quality of Stryker, Pello was designed for reliability and efficient cutting in ENT procedures.3

LEARN MORE

text_copy.text:
Bioresorbable dressings

Choose from nasal packings in a range of compression options for optimal hemostasis, support, stability, and adhesion prevention. Because our nasal packing products are resorbable, they clear through natural mucosal flow.

LEARN MORE

text.text:
XprESS ENT dilation system

The XprESS ENT dilation system delivers control and versatility for balloon dilation. Its seeker-based design and tip malleability provides tactile feel and flexibility to address complex anatomy for a broad range of patients.

Learn more

text_copy_copy_copy.text:
Hydro irrigation system

The Stryker Hydro irrigation system is your partner in ENT and neuro procedures. It simplifies sinuscope cleaning, restoring clarity with just a tap. It is designed to reduce delays from start to finish.1 It's visualization, enhanced.

LEARN MORE

text.text:
ClariFix cryotherapy device

Stryker’s ClariFix device goes straight to the root of chronic rhinitis - the overactive nerves. Using a minimally invasive treatment called cryotherapy, the ClariFix device applies focal, controlled freezing to target tissue.

LEARN MORE

text_copy.text:
LATERA absorbable nasal implant

The LATERA absorbable nasal implant supports the upper and lower lateral cartilage by anchoring above the maxilla to provide cantilever support.4 Nasal airway obstruction (NAO) is one of the most common complaints among patients who see an ENT physician, and its treatment can result in significant improvements in quality of life.5

learn more

Reinforced anesthesia needle

ENT surgeons select the reinforced anesthesia needle for its innovative design. The unique combination of a 27G tip and larger outer sleeve allows for a positive stop for injection depth precision.6

LEARN MORE

Audion

The Audion ET dilation system is a balloon dilation device specifically designed for the Eustachian tube to treat adults (18+) with eustachian tube dysfunction. It features an atraumatic tip with an enhanced flexible design, 45 degree angle, and 20mm leg length designed to help avoid critical anatomy.7

LEARN MORE

text.text:
Cliq suction pump

The Cliq suction pump is designed to deliver powerful performance and convenience. It features a twin cylinder diaphragm vacuum pump housed in an ergonomic case with collapsible handle and easy-to-read vacuum gauge.

LEARN MORE

text_copy.text:
Instruments

The MiniFESS family of surgical ENT instruments by Stryker is designed to streamline FESS procedures so you can precisely and conveniently treat patients in your preferred site of service.

LEARN MORE

text_copy_685171705.text:
Cyclone sinonasal suction and irrigation system

The dual-action performance of the Cyclone system is designed to facilitate a positive patient experience by minimizing pooling and drainage. Its unique single handed design includes a reshapeable distal hypotube that can be modified to suction and irrigate multiple sinus passages in the same patient.

LEARN MORE

largeheadline.line1: Provide patients with the outcomes they’re looking for

text.text: Many people suffer from chronic and recurrent ear, nose and throat conditions. Stryker provides ENT equipment to help you offer innovative treatment options for patients with chronic rhinitis, sinusitis, nasal airway obstruction and Eustachian tube dysfunction. Learn more about the ENT conditions that we specialize in.
